An [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''astromech droid'''<ref name="Cut and Run" /> of [[R-series]]<ref name="Cut and Run AD" /> was on the planet [[Saleucami]] in [[19 BBY]]. When [[Omega]] tried to get clearance codes, she accidentally bumped into the droid, who tried to sound the alarm before getting destroyed by [[Wrecker]] of [[Clone Force 99]].<ref name="Cut and Run" />

==Behind the scenes==
The astromech droid first appeared in the second episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'',<ref name="Cut and Run" /> which premiered on [[May 7]], [[2021]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> In the sixth episode, "[[Decommissioned]]", the astromech droid [[R7-A7]] had this droid's colors in the last minute of the episode.<ref name="Decommissioned">{{TBB|Decommissioned}}</ref>
